simple.summary: עָכַס (ʻâkaç) means to put on anklets First listed occurrence: Isa 3 16.

definitions.full: H5913. akas [ עָכַס ] verb denominative Pi`el shake bangles, rattle, tinkle ; — Imperfect 3feminine plural וּבְרַגְלֵיהֶם תְּעַכַּסְנָה Isa 3:16 and with their feet they rattle their bangles .
definitions.rootNote: a primitive root; properly, to tie, specifically, with fetters; but used only as denominative from 5914 ;
